meta.title: 自我介绍别写工具人属性标签
meta.title_en: Stop Labeling Yourself as a Tool in Your Self-Introduction

scenes.title_cn: 建立账号先写自我介绍
scenes.title_en: Start your account with a self-introduction
scenes.context: 讲者开场：元宇宙世代，网络上没有名号就等于不存在，不管哪个平台都要建立输出观点的账号，而第一步是写一段自我介绍。
sentences: 如果你在网络上没有名号，就等于你不存在。
If you have no identity online, you might as well not exist.
名号：identity / presence
不管在哪个平台，你都要建立一个输出自己观点的账号。
On any platform, you need an account that voices your views.
输出观点：voice your views
建账号的第一步，是写一段自我介绍。
The first step of building an account is writing a self-introduction.
第一步：the first step
paraphrase: 网络无名号 → 等于不存在
No online identity means no presence at all.
建立账号 → 先写自我介绍
An account starts with a self-introduction.
scenes.speak: If you have no identity online, you might as well not exist. On any platform, you need an account that voices your views. The first step of building an account is writing a self-introduction.

scenes.title_cn: 工具人属性标签的代价
scenes.context: 讲者反思自己写过的十几个自我介绍版本：一线德国公司职业经理人、擅长工作方法论——这些是外部评价、工具人属性的标签，粉丝用完就走。
sentences: 以前的自我介绍：一线德国公司的职业经理人，擅长工作方法论。
My old intro: a professional manager at a top German company, good at work methodologies.
擅长：good at
这些是外部评价、工具人属性的标签。
These are externally-given, tool-person labels.
工具人属性：tool-person labels
粉丝只会在需要工作逻辑推理时来看你，用完就走。
Followers only drop by when they need work logic, then leave once used.
用完就走：leave once used
paraphrase: 饭碗标签 → 不是个人标签
A job title is a label for the job, not for you.
工具人标签 → 粉丝用完就走
Tool labels attract users, not friends.
scenes.speak: My old intro: a professional manager at a top German company, good at work methodologies. These are externally-given, tool-person labels. Followers only drop by when they need work logic, then leave once used.

scenes.context: 讲者给出正解：自我介绍是自己给自己贴标签，真正的标签是内部评价，即经典的哲学三问——我是谁、我从哪里来、我要到哪里去。
sentences: 自我介绍是自己给自己贴标签。
A self-introduction is a label you give yourself.
给自己贴标签：label yourself
你是谁，你有什么想让别人记住的，更重要的是你怎么看自己。
Who you are, what you want to be remembered for — and above all, how you see yourself.
更重要的是：above all
真正的标签是内部评价：我是谁、我从哪里来、我要到哪里去。
True labels come from internal evaluation: who am I, where do I come from, where am I going.
内部评价：internal evaluation
paraphrase: 外部标签 → 饭碗标签
External labels belong to the job, not the person.
内部评价 → 哲学三问
scenes.speak: A self-introduction is a label you give yourself. Who you are, what you want to be remembered for — and above all, how you see yourself. True labels come from internal evaluation: who am I, where do I come from, where am I going.

practice: On any platform, build an account that voices your views.
True labels come from internal evaluation.
Who am I, where do I come from, where am I going?
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：My name on the internet doesn't exist.
✓ 地道说法：If you have no identity online, you might as well not exist.
might as well not exist 更地道。
✕ 直译腔：I am good at work methods.
✓ 地道说法：I'm good at work methodologies.
methodology 比 methods 更符合讲者语义。
工具人属性标签是中式表达，用 tool-person labels 简化。
✕ 直译腔：The most important is how you look at yourself.
✓ 地道说法：Above all, how you see yourself.
shifts: 把自我介绍写成「简历复述」
把自我介绍写成「自我定义」
用饭碗、公司名给自己贴标签
用哲学三问做内部评价
